text:
Sam (People Ops): Tiny manager-ready onepager for new hires: copy, paste, adapt. Keep day1 light and make week1 checklist explicit.

Marta: Love the brevity. Add a "who to ping" mini matrix?

Sam (People Ops): Added below. Also a 7-day signoff so hires don't fall through cracks.

Devin: Can we include an optional async standup line for global teams?

Sam (People Ops): Noted: "15min daily huddle or async standup depending on timezone."

OnboardBot: Laptop provisioning: order queued (ETA 3 business days).

Sam (People Ops): Single-page content: 

WEEK0 (manager prep, 20-30m): send welcome + calendar invites, create access ticket (Okta, Slack, GitHub, Drive, cloud role), pick buddy, draft 3x90 goals.

DAY1 (keep <4 meetings): 09:30-10:15 manager 1:1 (role & 90d goals), 11:00-11:30 team intro (record), 14:00-14:30 buddy session (env + first PR), 16:30 quick manager pulse.

DAYS2-5: 10:00 15min daily huddle (live or async), schedule 2 deep dives (product + infra).

ACCESS MATRIX: GitHub -> @dev-platform; Okta/Slack -> @it-support; Cloud -> @infra-ops. If blocked DM Sam.

DAY7 signoff (3 bullets): small PR merged with buddy, env confirmed, 30-day feedback scheduled.

30/60/90 (one liners): 30d orient & ship a small fix; 60d own a feature; 90d lead an end-to-end project.

Marta: Perfect, using this for my new hire.

Sam (People Ops): I'll upload MD+PDF to the onboarding repo and post link here.
